# Svgbob

Svgbob can create a nice graphical representation of your text diagrams.

Svgbob provides a CLI which takes text as an input and creates an SVG image as an output.

## Demo

[**Interactive Demo**](https://ivanceras.github.io/svgbob-editor/)

## What is Svgbob?

Svgbob is a tool that converts ASCII art text diagrams into beautiful SVG graphics. It automatically recognizes shapes, lines, arrows, and text in your ASCII art and renders them as scalable vector graphics.

## Features

- Converts ASCII art diagrams to SVG
- Supports various shapes: rectangles, circles, lines, arrows
- Handles text within diagrams
- Customizable styling via legends
- Command-line interface for easy integration
- Server mode available for REST API usage

## Usage Examples

### Basic ASCII Art to SVG

Input:
```
    +------+
    |      |
    +------+
```

### Command Line Options

The CLI tool supports various options:

- `--background <color>` - Set backdrop background color (default: white)
- `--fill-color <color>` - Set fill color for solid shapes (default: black)
- `--stroke-color <color>` - Set stroke color for lines (default: black)
- `--font-family <font>` - Set font family for text (default: arial)
- `--font-size <size>` - Set font size (default: 14)
- `--stroke-width <width>` - Set stroke width for lines (default: 2)
- `--scale <factor>` - Scale the entire SVG by this factor (default: 1)
- `-o, --output <file>` - Output file (default: STDOUT)
- `-s, --inline` - Parse an inline string

### Server Mode

Svgbob can also run as a REST API server. Send ASCII art as a POST request and receive SVG output.

## Specification

For detailed information about the diagram syntax and supported features, see the [Specification](https://ivanceras.github.io/content/Svgbob/Specification.html).

## Used By

- [google/comprehensive-rust](https://github.com/google/comprehensive-rust) via [markdown-svgbob](https://github.com/boozook/mdbook-svgbob)
- [asciidoctor](https://docs.asciidoctor.org/diagram-extension/latest/diagram_types/svgbob/)
- [discourse](https://meta.discourse.org/t/discourse-svgbob/223573)
- [typst/bob-draw](https://typst.app/universe/package/bob-draw/)
- [zola](https://zola.discourse.group/t/diagramming-tool-integrations-plantuml-svgbob-graphviz-etc/269)
- [kroki](https://kroki.io/)

--- server docs ---
# Svgbob Server

Svgbob Server runs svgbob as a REST API, allowing you to convert ASCII art diagrams to SVG via HTTP requests.

## Usage

Start the server on a specific port and send POST requests with your ASCII art:

```sh
curl -X POST -F 'ascii=o------>' http://localhost:3000 > output.svg
```

The server accepts ASCII art as form data and returns the rendered SVG.

  fill: black;
  font-family: Iosevka Fixed, monospace;
  font-size: 14px;
}

.svgbob rect.backdrop {
  stroke: none;
  fill: white;
}

.svgbob .broken {
  stroke-dasharray: 8;
}

.svgbob .filled {
  fill: black;
}

.svgbob .bg_filled {
  fill: white;
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.svgbob .nofill {
  fill: white;
}

.svgbob .end_marked_arrow {
  marker-end: url(#arrow);
}

.svgbob .start_marked_arrow {
  marker-start: url(#arrow);
}

.svgbob .end_marked_diamond {
  marker-end: url(#diamond);
}

.svgbob .start_marked_diamond {
  marker-start: url(#diamond);
}

.svgbob .end_marked_circle {
  marker-end: url(#circle);
}

  marker-start: url(#circle);
}

import subprocess,json,re
chars='-~|:+XxoO*#<>^vV.,\'`_/\\=()─│┄┆┌┬┼○●◆□'
for d,(dx,dy) in {'right':(1,0),'below':(0,1),'downright':(1,1),'downleft':(-1,1)}.items():
 print('\nPLUS',d)
 for c in chars:
  grid={ (1,0):'+',(1+dx,dy):c}
  s='\n'.join(''.join(grid.get((x,y),' ') for x in range(3)).rstrip() for y in range(dy+1))
  p=subprocess.run(['./executable','-s','--',s],capture_output=True,text=True)
  body=p.stdout.split('  <rect class="backdrop"')[1].split('\n',1)[1].removesuffix('</svg>\n')
  print(repr(c),re.sub(r'\s*\n\s*',' ',body).strip())
  json.dump({'in':s,'out':p.stdout,'err':p.stderr,'code':p.returncode},open(f'.probe/plus_{d}_{ord(c)}.json','w'))
PY

{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,re,json
for w in range(3,16):
 for bot in ['`',"'"]:
  s=' .'+('-'*(w-4) if w>=4 else '')+('.' if w>=4 else '')+'\n('+' '*(w-2)+')\n '+bot+('-'*(w-4) if w>=4 else '')+("'" if w>=4 else '')
  p=subprocess.run(['./executable','-s','--',s],capture_output=True,text=True)
  json.dump({'in':s,'out':p.stdout,'err':p.stderr,'code':p.returncode},open(f'.probe/circular{w:03}{ord(bot)}.json','w'))
  body=p.stdout[p.stdout.find('  <rect class="backdrop"'):].split('\n',1)[1].removesuffix('</svg>\n')
  print('WIDTH',w,'bot',bot, re.sub(r'\s*\n\s*',' ',body).strip())
print('\n--- legend grammar ---')
legends=['a {fill: red;}','a: {fill:red;}','{a} = {fill: red;}','a = {fill: red;}','{a}: {fill: red;}','"a" {fill: red;}','"a": {fill: red;}','a = "fill:red;"','a: "fill:red;"','{a}: "fill:red;"','{a} = "fill:red;"','a = {"fill":"red"}','"a": {"fill":"red"}','{"a": {"fill":"red"}}','{"a": "fill:red;"}','a { fill: "red" }','{a} fill=red','{a}:fill: red','a {\nfill: red;\n}','a: {\nfill: red;\n}','{a} {fill:red;}','{a} = fill: red;','a = fill: red;','a:fill:red;','{a}\nfill:red;','a {\n  fill: red\n  stroke: blue\n}']
for i,legend in enumerate(legends):
 s='+---+\n|{a}|\n+---+\n\n# Legend:\n'+legend
 p=subprocess.run(['./executable','-s','--',s],capture_output=True,text=True)
 # Show changes beyond the default definitions.
 extra=p.stdout[p.stdout.find('.svgbob .start_marked_big_open_circle'):p.stdout.find('</style>')].split('}\n\n',1)[-1]
 print(repr(legend),repr(extra),p.stderr.strip())
 json.dump({'in':s,'out':p.stdout,'err':p.stderr,'code':p.returncode},open(f'.probe/css{i:03}.json','w'))
PY"}

"""Regression tests for the observable text-diagram format and CLI."""
import contextlib
import io
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from main import convert
from svg import f32, number


def body(source, **options):
    svg = convert(source, options)
    return svg.split('  <rect class="backdrop"', 1)[1].split('\n', 1)[1]


class RenderingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_and_padding(self):
        out = convert('\n    \n', {})
        self.assertTrue(out.startswith('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="32"'))
        self.assertTrue(out.endswith('width="16" height="32"></rect>\n</svg>\n'))
        self.assertIn('width="40" height="48"', convert(' abc \n d\n\n', {}))

    def test_text_cells_and_escaping(self):
        self.assertEqual(body('a & <tag>'),
                         '  <text x="2" y="12" >a</text>\n'
                         '  <text x="18" y="12" >&</text>\n'
                         '  <text x="34" y="12" ><tag></text>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('a   b\nc'),
                         '  <text x="2" y="12" >a</text>\n'
                         '  <text x="2" y="28" >c</text>\n'
                         '  <text x="34" y="12" >b</text>\n</svg>\n')

    def test_quoted_labels(self):
        out = convert('"a-b <c>"', {})
        self.assertIn('width="16" height="32"', out)
        self.assertEqual(body('"a-b <c>"'),
                         '  <text x="2" y="12" >a-b <c></text>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('"你好" "bye"'),
                         '  <text x="2" y="12" >你好</text>\n'
                         '  <text x="58" y="12" >bye</text>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('a\0b'),
                         '  <text x="2" y="12" >a</text>\n'
                         '  <text x="18" y="12" >b</text>\n</svg>\n')

    def test_lines_and_junctions(self):
        self.assertEqual(body('  |\n--+--\n  |'),
                         '  <line x1="20" y1="0" x2="20" y2="48" class="solid"></line>\n'
                         '  <line x1="0" y1="24" x2="40" y2="24" class="solid"></line>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('--+\n  |'),
                         '  <g>\n'
                         '    <line x1="0" y1="8" x2="20" y2="8" class="solid"></line>\n'
                         '    <line x1="20" y1="8" x2="20" y2="32" class="solid"></line>\n'
                         '  </g>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertIn('class="broken"', body('!\n:\n|'))

    def test_rectangles(self):
        self.assertEqual(body('+---+\n| a |\n+---+'),
                         '  <rect x="4" y="8" width="32" height="32" class="solid nofill" rx="0"></rect>\n'
                         '  <text x="18" y="28" >a</text>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('.---.\n| a |\n\'---\''),
                         '  <rect x="4" y="8" width="32" height="32" class="solid nofill" rx="4"></rect>\n'
                         '  <text x="18" y="28" >a</text>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('┌───┐\n│ a │\n└───┘'), body('+---+\n| a |\n+---+'))

    def test_arrows_and_markers(self):
        self.assertEqual(body('o-->'),
                         '  <line x1="16" y1="8" x2="4" y2="8" class="solid end_marked_open_circle"></line>\n'
                         '  <line x1="16" y1="8" x2="24" y2="8" class="solid"></line>\n'
                         '  <polygon points="24,4 32,8 24,12" class="filled"></polygon>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('\\\n v'),
                         '  <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="10" y2="20" class="solid"></line>\n'
                         '  <polygon points="7,20 14,28 14,17" class="filled"></polygon>\n</svg>\n')

    def test_circles(self):
        self.assertEqual(body(' .--.\n( hi )\n `--\''),
                         '  <circle cx="24" cy="24" r="20" class="nofill"></circle>\n'
                         '  <text x="18" y="28" >hi</text>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('x ()'),
                         '  <circle cx="24" cy="8" r="4" class="nofill"></circle>\n'
                         '  <text x="2" y="12" >x</text>\n</svg>\n')

    def test_styling(self):
        source = '+---+\n|{a}|\n+---+\n\n# Legend:\na = {fill:red;}'
        out = convert(source, {'scale': 2, 'font-size': 18, 'stroke-width': 1.5,
                               'stroke-color': 'blue', 'background': 'none'})
        self.assertIn('width="96" height="128"', out)
        self.assertIn('font-size: 18px;', out)
        self.assertIn('stroke-width: 1.5;', out)
        self.assertIn('.svgbob .a{ fill:red; }</style>', out)
        self.assertIn('class="solid nofill a"', out)
        self.assertNotIn('>{a}</text>', out)

    def test_single_precision_formatting(self):
        self.assertEqual(number(f32(0.1) * 16), '1.6')
        self.assertEqual(number(f32(1e30) * 16), '16000000000000000000000000000000')
        self.assertEqual(number(float('nan')), 'NaN')
        self.assertEqual(number(-0.0), '-0')


class CliTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_cli(self, *args, input=''):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / 'main.py'), *args],
                              input=input, capture_output=True, text=True)

    def test_version_and_help(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('--version').stdout, 'svgbob 0.7.6\n')
        self.assertIn('USAGE:', self.run_cli('--help').stdout)
        self.assertIn('Batch convert files', self.run_cli('help', 'build').stdout)

    def test_stdin_and_inline(self):
        a = self.run_cli(input='A\nB')
        b = self.run_cli('-s', '--', 'A\\nB')
        self.assertEqual(a.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(a.stdout, b.stdout)
        # Positional strings similar to a subcommand trigger suggestions.
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('-s', 'hello').returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('-s', '--', 'hello').returncode, 0)

    def test_output_file(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = os.path.join(directory, 'result.svg')
            proc = self.run_cli('-s', 'abc', '-o', path)
            self.assertEqual((proc.returncode, proc.stdout), (0, ''))
            self.assertEqual(Path(path).read_text(), convert('abc', {}).rstrip('\n'))

    def test_batch_conversion(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            Path(directory, 'one.bob').write_text('one')
            Path(directory, 'two.bob').write_text('two')
            out = os.path.join(directory, 'out')
            proc = self.run_cli('--scale', 'bad', 'build', '-i', directory+'/*.bob', '-o', out)
            self.assertEqual(proc.returncode, 1)
            self.assertEqual(Path(out, 'one.svg').read_text(), convert('one', {}).rstrip('\n'))
            self.assertEqual(Path(out, 'two.svg').read_text(), convert('two', {}).rstrip('\n'))

"""Regression tests for the observable text-diagram format and CLI."""
import contextlib
import io
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from main import convert
from svg import f32, number


def body(source, **options):
    svg = convert(source, options)
    return svg.split('  <rect class="backdrop"', 1)[1].split('\n', 1)[1]


class RenderingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_and_padding(self):
        out = convert('\n    \n', {})
        self.assertTrue(out.startswith('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="32"'))
        self.assertTrue(out.endswith('width="16" height="32"></rect>\n</svg>\n'))
        self.assertIn('width="40" height="48"', convert(' abc \n d\n\n', {}))

    def test_text_cells_and_escaping(self):
        self.assertEqual(body('a & <tag>'),
                         '  <text x="2" y="12" >a</text>\n'
                         '  <text x="18" y="12" >&</text>\n'
                         '  <text x="34" y="12" ><tag></text>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('a   b\nc'),
                         '  <text x="2" y="12" >a</text>\n'
                         '  <text x="2" y="28" >c</text>\n'
                         '  <text x="34" y="12" >b</text>\n</svg>\n')

    def test_quoted_labels(self):
        out = convert('"a-b <c>"', {})
        self.assertIn('width="16" height="32"', out)
        self.assertEqual(body('"a-b <c>"'),
                         '  <text x="2" y="12" >a-b <c></text>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('"你好" "bye"'),
                         '  <text x="2" y="12" >你好</text>\n'
                         '  <text x="58" y="12" >bye</text>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('a\0b'),
                         '  <text x="2" y="12" >a</text>\n'
                         '  <text x="18" y="12" >b</text>\n</svg>\n')

    def test_lines_and_junctions(self):
        self.assertEqual(body('  |\n--+--\n  |'),
                         '  <line x1="20" y1="0" x2="20" y2="48" class="solid"></line>\n'
                         '  <line x1="0" y1="24" x2="40" y2="24" class="solid"></line>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('--+\n  |'),
                         '  <g>\n'
                         '    <line x1="0" y1="8" x2="20" y2="8" class="solid"></line>\n'
                         '    <line x1="20" y1="8" x2="20" y2="32" class="solid"></line>\n'
                         '  </g>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertIn('class="broken"', body('!\n:\n|'))

    def test_rectangles(self):
        self.assertEqual(body('+---+\n| a |\n+---+'),
                         '  <rect x="4" y="8" width="32" height="32" class="solid nofill" rx="0"></rect>\n'
                         '  <text x="18" y="28" >a</text>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('.---.\n| a |\n\'---\''),
                         '  <rect x="4" y="8" width="32" height="32" class="solid nofill" rx="4"></rect>\n'
                         '  <text x="18" y="28" >a</text>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('┌───┐\n│ a │\n└───┘'), body('+---+\n| a |\n+---+'))

    def test_arrows_and_markers(self):
        self.assertEqual(body('o-->'),
                         '  <line x1="16" y1="8" x2="4" y2="8" class="solid end_marked_open_circle"></line>\n'
                         '  <line x1="16" y1="8" x2="24" y2="8" class="solid"></line>\n'
                         '  <polygon points="24,4 32,8 24,12" class="filled"></polygon>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('\\\n v'),
                         '  <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="10" y2="20" class="solid"></line>\n'
                         '  <polygon points="7,20 14,28 14,17" class="filled"></polygon>\n</svg>\n')

    def test_circles(self):
        self.assertEqual(body(' .--.\n( hi )\n `--\''),
                         '  <circle cx="24" cy="24" r="20" class="nofill"></circle>\n'
                         '  <text x="18" y="28" >hi</text>\n</svg>\n')
        self.assertEqual(body('x ()'),
                         '  <circle cx="24" cy="8" r="4" class="nofill"></circle>\n'
                         '  <text x="2" y="12" >x</text>\n</svg>\n')

    def test_styling(self):
        source = '+---+\n|{a}|\n+---+\n\n# Legend:\na = {fill:red;}'
        out = convert(source, {'scale': 2, 'font-size': 18, 'stroke-width': 1.5,
                               'stroke-color': 'blue', 'background': 'none'})
        self.assertIn('width="96" height="128"', out)
        self.assertIn('font-size: 18px;', out)
        self.assertIn('stroke-width: 1.5;', out)
        self.assertIn('.svgbob .a{ fill:red; }</style>', out)
        self.assertIn('class="solid nofill a"', out)
        self.assertNotIn('>{a}</text>', out)

    def test_single_precision_formatting(self):
        self.assertEqual(number(f32(0.1) * 16), '1.6')
        self.assertEqual(number(f32(1e30) * 16), '16000000000000000000000000000000')
        self.assertEqual(number(float('nan')), 'NaN')
        self.assertEqual(number(-0.0), '-0')


class CliTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_cli(self, *args, input=''):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / 'main.py'), *args],
                              input=input, capture_output=True, text=True)

    def test_version_and_help(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('--version').stdout, 'svgbob 0.7.6\n')
        self.assertIn('USAGE:', self.run_cli('--help').stdout)
        self.assertIn('Batch convert files', self.run_cli('help', 'build').stdout)

    def test_stdin_and_inline(self):
        a = self.run_cli(input='A\nB')
        b = self.run_cli('-s', '--', 'A\\nB')
        self.assertEqual(a.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(a.stdout, b.stdout)
        # Positional strings similar to a subcommand trigger suggestions.
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('-s', 'hello').returncode, 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('-s', '--', 'hello').returncode, 0)

    def test_output_file(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = os.path.join(directory, 'result.svg')
            proc = self.run_cli('-s', 'abc', '-o', path)
            self.assertEqual((proc.returncode, proc.stdout), (0, ''))
            self.assertEqual(Path(path).read_text(), convert('abc', {}).rstrip('\n'))

    def test_batch_conversion(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            Path(directory, 'one.bob').write_text('one')
            Path(directory, 'two.bob').write_text('two')
            out = os.path.join(directory, 'out')
            proc = self.run_cli('--scale', 'bad', 'build', '-i', directory+'/*.bob', '-o', out)
            self.assertEqual(proc.returncode, 1)
            self.assertEqual(Path(out, 'one.svg').read_text(), convert('one', {}).rstrip('\n'))
            self.assertEqual(Path(out, 'two.svg').read_text(), convert('two', {}).rstrip('\n'))

    def test_argument_errors(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('--font-size', '1.5').stderr,
                         'Illegal value for argument font-size: invalid digit found in string\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('--scale', 'bad').stderr,
                         'Illegal value for argument scale: invalid float literal\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('--inline', 'abc').returncode, 1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
